title: Multiple Content-Encodings listed in order of encoding application
summary: Content-Encoding: gzip, br means gzip was applied first and Brotli second. Decode Brotli before gzip.
applies: HTTP representation and offline message parsing
detail: Transfer-Encoding describes message transmission, and Content-Encoding describes the representation itself, which belongs to different layers when restored offline.
boundary: The packet capture viewer may have removed one of the layers; decoding it again will report that the header is invalid.
relevance: Explains why a response can declare gzip even when the raw payload does not start with a gzip header.
